_comment: Questions per demo folder (keys match data/demo/<key>). Each exercises a different retrieval route: tables, page lookups, structured voter records, semantic prose.
pmp: What is the proposed land use percentage for residential use?
What is on page 66 of the master plan?
What is the projected population of Patna for 2031?
What are the widths of the major roads?
Which agencies are responsible for implementing the master plan?
rolls: What is the name and address of the polling station?
How many total voters are in this part?
How many male and female voters are there?
What are the details of serial number 10?
paper: What is the main contribution of this paper?
What methodology or dataset does the study use?
What limitations do the authors mention?
What does the paper recommend for future work?
